newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision eyes cable financial partner - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision eyes cable financial partner - WSJ.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp is pursuing several debt-reduction plans including lining up a strategic financial partner for all or part of its cable and programming operations, the Wall Street Journal said.
The company made the announcement at a private meeting Friday with analysts and investors, the paper said in Monday's electronic edition.

Cablevision was considering either a partner for Cablevision or for its Rainbow Programming Holdings unit, the paper said. A possible partner would be General Electric Co's NBC, which owned stakes in different Rainbow Programming properties, the paper said.
People familiar with Cablevision said it also held talks with suitors like Walt Disney and Liberty Media, the paper said.
Chief Executive Jim Dolan re-emphasized the company's plan to sell as much as $1 billion in cable systems in nonessential markets and boost cash flow this year, the paper said.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
